description: A painting of armored horsemen crossing a churned, flooded river at dusk. In the right foreground a rider in a plumed turban and mail armour on a grey, armoured horse, with a gold-trimmed saddle cloth, splashes into the water. Behind him, mail-clad riders with swords and lances charge down a muddy bank. Smoke and a small fire glow in the distance under a dark stormy sky. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.
